question_text: What design flow rate should the P&ID use?

question_text: What pump duty should be assumed?

AI assumption/rationale: Assume medium pressure duty appropriate for pump-fed pressure-driven contactors and potential cartridge prefilters; influences pump selection, piping class, relief valves. Human review required for upstream/downstream pressure drops and any membrane/RO components.

question_text: What downstream treatment configuration should be shown?
